What you actually own

An edition, not a poster.

Signed

Hand-signed by the artist and released in a strictly limited, numbered edition.

Certified

Each work ships with a certificate of authenticity naming the artist, edition and number.

Lab-crafted

Printed as an archival pigment print or C-print and finished by hand — Diasec, framed, or artbox.

Lasting

Made to museum standards with archival materials chosen to hold their colour for generations.

Since 2004

Liberation of Arts

LUMAS was founded on a simple idea: that original, museum-grade art should belong in homes, not only in vaults. Signed editions from over 500 artists, across 19 galleries in 7 countries — priced to be lived with.

Good to know

Questions collectors ask us.

Yes. Every LUMAS work is a signed, numbered edition released in a strictly limited run and shipped with a certificate of authenticity naming the artist, edition and number.

Editions are produced as archival pigment prints or C-prints and finished by hand. You can choose framing, a frameless Diasec face-mount, or an artbox — each made to order for your work.

Because each edition is crafted and framed to order, most works are produced and shipped within a few weeks. Larger and specially finished works can take a little longer; your confirmation gives the estimate for your piece.

You have a 60-day right of return on every edition. Live with the work, see it in your light, and if it isn't right, return it.

Instalment options are available in most markets at checkout, so you can spread the cost of a larger edition over time. The exact provider and terms depend on your region.

No. You can find and order your edition entirely online, with the ArtFinder and on-wall previews to guide you — or visit one of our 19 galleries across 7 countries if you'd rather see the work in person first.

About LUMAS — Founded in Berlin in 2004, LUMAS makes original, signed and numbered fine-art photography editions accessible to collectors at home. Works are hand-signed by the artist, released in strictly limited editions, certified for authenticity, and produced to museum standards as archival pigment prints, C-prints and Diasec face-mounts. LUMAS represents over 500 artists and 4,500 works across 19 galleries in 7 countries, with a 60-day right of return on every edition.
